decision: DIFFERS -> W1: today's [1,3] is a SOWING density (Cornell: 'Plant ... 1 inch apart' then thin), never the in-row figure where a page states a thinned spacing. Two cited pages state a thinned figure: VH021 Table 1 'Arugula ... 3-4 | 10' (Florida; rows a minimum 10) and uwi_hort arugula "Thin seedlings to 3 to 6 inches apart for individual plants, or leave denser plantings for cut-and-come-again treatment." The UW sentence is a crop-specific prose recommendation whose range contains the crop's own full-plant prose (4 to 6), so it authors -> in_row [3,6]; no row figure on UW (not_authored; VH021's minimum 10 is on a second page, not joined under W6). The prose keeps its two regimes (baby-leaf 1 to 3 dense, full plants 4 to 6): the full-plant figure sits inside the entry and the baby-leaf density is the cut-and-come-again regime the UW sentence names: agrees.
